notes: Source: Zijin Mining Group 2025 Annual Report (minedocs.com PDF; English translation). Group mine-produced gold 89,544 kg (~90 t, +23% YoY) in 2025; attributable 75,144 kg. Guided 2025 net profit attributable RMB51-52B (+59-62% YoY); revenue from gold business 44.43% of operating income. Per-mine production figures are on 100% gross basis as reported in the 'Major gold mines or enterprises' table (Zhaojin Mining, an 18.20% associate holding, excluded — it is a listed-company investment, not an operating mine). Reserves shown on 100% gross basis in metal tonnes from the annual report reserve tables (grade cut-offs and US$2,700/oz resource / US$2,200/oz reserve metal price assumptions except Porgera US$2,000/1,500). Reserve ore tonnage (Mt) derived from metal tonnes / reserve grade. Buriticá, Rosebel, Norton, Zeravshan, Akyem, Aurora, Altynken and Porgera are held through Zijin Gold International (listed HKEX 2259 on 30 Sep 2025); group interests were diluted accordingly vs 2259.HK figures. Other mines (3,909 kg) and refineries excluded. Acquisitions in 2025: Akyem (Ghana, April), Raygorodok (Kazakhstan, Oct), controlling stake in Zangge Mining (April; lifted Julong interest to 58.16%).
